theme_and_colors.theme_mode: Hybrid with Dark/Light Toggle (Default: High-contrast BTP Slate Light & Deep Obsidian Dark)
theme_and_colors.archetype: Architectural Precision & Performance Pro (Swiss High-Contrast + Warm Amber Accent)

typography.font_files_note: Use standard React font imports or Google Fonts inside public/index.html or CSS

spacing_and_layout.density: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards)
spacing_and_layout.table_density: Compact & Readable with row hover states and sticky header

visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle 1px border (border-border/60), cardless/flat geometry with crisp shadows, rounded-xl
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border border-border/50 for sticky filters and top navigation
visual_enhancers.badges: Status badges with subtle background tint and vibrant border (Reliable = Green, To Verify = Amber, Obsolete = Red)
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Smooth 150ms transitions on hover/focus, active states on data table rows and KPI cards

key_components_to_build.1_header_saas_bar: Global BlueSeaTra topbar with project switcher, supplier status indicator, theme toggle, and CSV catalogue import/export controls
key_components_to_build.2_kpi_summary_grid: 4 key cards: Total Catalogue Articles, Estimated Project Budget (HT/Marge/TVA/TTC), Supplier Reliability Score, Price Alert Counter
key_components_to_build.3_catalogue_data_table: Search by reference/designation, filter by Lot (16 categories) & Supplier (8 suppliers) & Reliability status. Quick add to Estimation Basket
key_components_to_build.4_project_estimator_workspace: Interactive project builder where users add articles, set quantities, adjust custom margin (%), calculate HT/TVA 20%/TTC with real-time Recharts breakdown
key_components_to_build.5_analytics_visualizations: Recharts Bar & Pie graphs for Cost Distribution by Lot, Supplier Price Comparison, and Margin Analysis
key_components_to_build.6_alerts_and_audit_drawer: Panel identifying articles needing price re-verification or missing packaging details

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, filters, inputs, KPI cards, table rows, and modal triggers MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all monetary values are clearly formatted as Euro (€) with French formatting (e.g., 1 250,50 € HT / 1 500,60 € TTC).
Implement precise mathematical calculations: Prix Vente HT = Prix Achat HT / (1 - Marge%), Montant TVA = Prix Vente HT * 0.20, Total TTC = Prix Vente HT + TVA.
Use pure JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the frontend repository.
Utilize lucide-react icons for clear, crisp BTP status icons (Layers, ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle, Truck, Calculator, Download, Search, Filter).
Ensure Sonner toast notifications trigger whenever items are added/removed from estimates or when price updates occur.
Ensure the UI layout looks native to BlueSeaTra SaaS (clean sidebar/topbar navigation with smooth tab switching between Catalogue, Estimateur de Projet, and Analytics KPI).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all globally; target specific properties like border-color, background-color, opacity.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_centered_app: Avoid centering the main container. Text and data tables must align naturally to the left.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessible_contrast: Ensure text over table headers, badges, and dark cards meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_library: Use sonner for user feedback toasts.
